_doc: Critique Lab — example config. Copy to config.json and customize. Both .env and config.json are gitignored.
_doc_models: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: leave the `models` block out and route through Podbit via `podbit.url` below. Podbit owns model assignment, semaphore-based concurrency, rate-limit cooldowns, budget tracking, and per-subsystem prompt/temperature config. Critique-lab is LLM-only (no sandbox compute) so the model choice matters even more — use the assignment system, not a hardcoded apiKey.
_doc_recommended_setup: 1. Run Podbit with your model registry configured (Models page). 2. Assign a model to the `lab:critique-lab` subsystem on the Podbit Models page. 3. Set PODBIT_URL in critique-lab/.env to point at your Podbit API (default http://localhost:4710). 4. Delete or comment out the entire `models` block below. 5. Done — every critique call now flows through Podbit's semaphore.

podbit._doc: When set, lab-core routes ALL LLM calls through Podbit's /api/llm/call proxy. The `subsystem` is the model registry assignment slot — assign a model to it on the Podbit Models page. With this configured, the `models` block below can be removed entirely.

specTypes.node_critique: Evaluate a knowledge graph node for quality. Assesses: specificity (vague vs precise), novelty (does it add insight beyond its sources?), grounding (supported by evidence or handwaving?), falsifiability (could it be tested or contradicted?), clarity (well-stated?). Returns a verdict: supported (high-value node), refuted (low-value — should be archived or reworked), inconclusive (needs improvement). No computation — pure LLM analysis.

_doc_models_block: FALLBACK ONLY — uncomment if you cannot route through Podbit (e.g. standalone smoke test, CI without a Podbit instance). Hits the provider directly with no semaphore, no budget, no rate-limit cooldown. NEVER commit a real apiKey here — the file is gitignored locally but using env vars is safer (LLM_API_KEY overrides the apiKey field).
